title: Qwen 3.6 27B dense on RX 7900 XTX (llama.cpp Vulkan): >60 tok/s (beats ROCm's 40 tok/s)
summary: AMD RX 7900 XTX. Qwen 3.6 27B dense. Runtime: llama.cpp (Vulkan backend). Métricas: >60 tokens/s generation (previously 40 t/s with ROCm on same hardware). Uso: local inference / server on high-end AMD GPU. Límite: Vulkan currently outperforms ROCm for this llama.cpp workload on RDNA3. Por qué importa: Direct head-to-head: Vulkan backend delivers 50%+ higher tokens/s than ROCm on same 7900 XTX card. Practical signal for AMD GPU users choosing backend.
